messages:
PagerBot: [P1] auth-proxy detected anomalous token replay pattern. 4k req/min to /v1/generate across us-west-2 + us-east-1. Possible token scraping. Suspect source IP clusters and multiple user-agent signatures. Alerting @david_oncall and @carla_sec.

David_oncall: ack. joining bridge now. pinging ops.

Benji_eng: on it — grabbing recent logs. quick snippet from edge: 
```
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z GET /v1/generate 200 "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-85a..." src=3.54.23.11 ua="okhttp/4.9.0" user=svc-proxy
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z GET /v1/generate 200 "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-85a..." src=54.241.12.3 ua="python-requests/2.28" user=svc-proxy
```
Multiple distinct IPs but same token patterns.

Carla_sec: if they're replaying bearer tokens we should assume tokens were scraped from a forwarded log or debug dump. Immediate actions:
- block suspected IP clusters at WAF (temp drop)
- rotate any exposed service tokens (svc-proxy)
- snapshot logs for forensics (write-once) and scrub PII before retention
- set temporary stricter rate limits for token scope

Benji_eng: agreed. Preparing rotate script. running: 
```bash
./ops/rotate-service-token --service svc-proxy --force --notify=deploy-channel
```
ETA 6m. Will stage on us-west then us-east.

Fiona_custsuccess: do we have a list of potentially impacted customers? need to know if any paying customers see degraded traffic.

David_oncall: early signal indicates internal service tokens primarily. No obvious customer API key hits yet, but we'll confirm. Benji please mark which tokens are service vs customer.

Benji_eng: marking now. svc-proxy token = service-only (no customer scope). rotating now. posting rollout steps to #eng-oncall.

Legal_bot: retention note: preserve raw snapshot to secure evidence bucket with audit logging. Do not share outside incident response without approval.

Eli_ops: taking over mitigation at 1748800400 (handoff from David). Plan: 1) WAF block top 200 IPs for 1hr 2) rotate svc-proxy tokens globally 3) deploy token-introspection rate cap 4) push scrubbed log export to sec-bucket 5) monitor for fallback or customer impact.

David_oncall: handing off. i've documented actions taken so far in the bridge. leaving phone reachable.

Eli_ops: WAF blocks in place (rule id 83421). rotating tokens now. Rotation command output: 
```
START rotate svc-proxy - region us-west-2
OK rotated token svc-proxy-1 -> svc-proxy-1-v2
PUSHED config to routing layer
```
Proceeding to us-east-1.

Benji_eng: confirm that runtime KV caches will be flushed for old tokens. Pushing a rolling restart to proxies to purge caches | command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n redwood`

Carla_sec: forensic note: capture pre-rotation token list and associated request hashes. Also check CI/CD logs for accidental leak of tokens into build logs.

Eli_ops: snapshot created at s3://redwood-secure/incidents/1748800000/raw-snapshot-1. Access limited to sec+oncall.

Fiona_custsuccess: preparing a customer-facing statement in case any tenants ask. Will wait for confirmation that only internal tokens were affected.

Benji_eng: rotated everywhere. All proxies report new token. monitoring for 15m.

Carla_sec: background task: run grep on recent log exports for regex `sk-prod-[0-9a-f]{3}` and check for any customer ids in same lines. If found -> escalate to legal + custsuccess.

Eli_ops: monitoring shows drop in suspicious traffic after WAF block and rotation. rate back to baseline in us-west and us-east. No 5xx or customer-impacted errors observed.

David_oncall: thanks team. i'll stay on bridge for postmortem. if traffic resurges i'll re-escalate.

Carla_sec: follow-ups: 1) org-wide search for debug logger misconfig that may have forwarded tokens to logshipper 2) tighten logging scrubbing in edge 3) rotate any other service tokens that share perms with svc-proxy 4) schedule postmortem with remediation plan.

Fiona_custsuccess: will prep comms template and hold until we confirm scope.

Legal_bot: please preserve chain of custody for the S3 snapshot and note any data retention obligations.

Eli_ops: closing active mitigation at 1748800845. moving to monitoring/incidents follow-up.

David_oncall: incident de-escalated to P2 for follow-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:
